caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted candle holder with a candle. The candle holder is cylindrical and made of a material shaded in various tones of gray, representing metal. The top of the holder features draped, scalloped-edge detailing, with a small circular hole near the top center. At the bottom, a rounded base supports the main body. Inside the holder, a single, vertical candle colored in shades of light yellow and brown is positioned centrally. The candle is partially burned with a visible blackened wick. The background is plain and uncolored, with the only details being the drawn objects and the artist's signature below the base of the candle holder.
title: Candle Holder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
